rules:
fan extension = route + 20 mm (two joints with strain relief, 10 mm each) - the factory lead (FAN lead_len, the
active fan set: ARESWEI about 140 mm per the seller, measure on arrival), at least 40 mm so every fan unplugs at its nacelle on bullets (wiring.json missing: female bullets);
battery pigtail = route from the pack's XT60 + 20 mm; the pack's own lead ends with its XT60 22 mm behind the web
(CNHL lead length not published: assumed); routes are rounded up to 10 mm.

fan FL.path: fan window, arm bay, gusset windows, harness side run, rear crossing, ESC pad set 3

fan RL.path: arm bay outer end, gusset windows, harness side run, rear crossing, ESC pad set 4

battery L.path: lead window, arm bay, gusset windows, harness, rear crossing, up the ESC inboard edge, tabs from above

fan FR.path: fan window, arm bay, round the FC plate outboard edge, ESC pad set 1

fan RR.path: arm bay outer end, round the FC plate outboard edge, ESC pad set 2

battery R.path: lead window, arm bay, FC plate lead window, up between plate and ESC, tabs from the side

A7Z to FC.path: housing tops, along the header strip, right saddle side wall top, outboard of the rear window, y -35 behind the transition column, FC UART1 on the top edge
A7Z to FC.note: needed = route + 15 mm slack at each plug; the 300 mm lead leaves the rest coiled and tied
